entry.mode: Explicit ADSTABLE_DATASET_WRITE_ENABLED=true selects the dataset-only handler; existing native capture remains default when disabled. The fixed server plan must match the path provider.
entry.plan: ADSTABLE_DATASET_WRITE_PLAN: exact version/operationId/expiresAt/owner/batches/limits/useFx; POST body contains only matching operationId.
entry.authorization: Existing provider-specific private bearer secret, production/exact origin/path, bounded 1KiB body. No cookie/browser owner or row authority.
entry.credentials: Existing provider source-role TLS connection and distinct source cipher configuration; no new role, password or secret provisioned.

flow: validate existing narrow source-role profile and required storage extension
persist a bounded one-start operation marker in the primary existing source manifest
assert current owner and read original admitted context through fixed owner-checked RPC
optional fixed FX resolver using existing immutable merchant currency
atomic storage/retention write under the fixed plan operationId
known acknowledgement only: exact receipt readback
close checked transport and return minimal no-store summary
unknown: First error poisons transport; no automatic retry, alternate auth/role or unknown-write inspection. A lost start acknowledgement stays unknown. Durable source-manifest marker prevents same-plan restart across processes even if no Dataset receipt was received. Existing explicit historical inspection remains separate.
profile: Only fixed DATASET_STORAGE_RPC; no direct table, credential, currency selection, cleanup, grant, job finish or checkpoint SQL. Existing capture clients recognize only this reviewed optional extension and still cannot issue its SQL.
proofs: Missing/partial/empty/unknown remain distinct. No fake zero. Native values, source refs, three-year linked retention and mandatory erasure preserved. A storage receipt never marks source consumed or report publishable.
